remediations.action: Consolidated preprocessing logic into canonical preprocess_transaction function in data_generator.py and delegated all feature parsing in ExplainabilityService to it.
Bound active serving model instance explicitly from predict router into compute_shap_values(model=serving_model) and introduced thread-safe model-keyed caching.
Updated FastInferenceExplainer to report method='fast_heuristic' and source='FAST_HEURISTIC_COMPUTED'; updated predict router to report explanation_method truthfully.
Fixed AlertIntelligenceService._get_top_features so 'value' reports the actual feature value rather than being clobbered with contribution score.
Added as_of parameter to ExplainabilityService.explain_gnn_embedding and passed alert.created_at to bind GNN explanations to historical graph state.
Refactored Predictor.tsx and AlertsPage.tsx attribution rendering with directional +/- sign, emerald/rose styling, and continuous absolute magnitude bar widths.
Added tenant_id namespace to FastInferenceExplainer cache keys (cfi:shap:{tenant_id}:{transaction_id}) and implemented invalidate_cache method.
Enforced fail-closed validation on non-finite numeric input in preprocessing and asserted np.all(np.isfinite(shap_matrix)) before serialization.

Strengthened Kernel SHAP explainer cache key from (id(model), baseline.shape[0]) to (model_key, id(model), tuple(FEATURE_NAMES), baseline.shape, baseline_fp) using SHA-256 fingerprint of baseline bytes to guarantee background value and feature schema identity.

Expanded FastInferenceExplainer cache key builder from cfi:shap:{tenant}:{tx} to include model_version, as_of timestamp, and SHA-256 fingerprint of normalized feature vector, guaranteeing multi-dimensional cache isolation.
